title: Vowel Counter
description: Count vowels in a string, track each vowel type, and return detailed counts.

steps.title: Check if a character is a vowel
steps.description: Write an `isVowel` function that returns `true` if a character is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u).
hints: Check if the character is one of the five vowels
Use includes() or a switch statement

verification.failureMessage: isVowel('a') should be true, isVowel('b') should be false.

steps.title: Count vowels in a string
steps.description: Write a `countVowels` function that counts all vowels in a string using a loop.
hints: Loop through each character of the string
Use isVowel() to check each character
Increment a counter for each vowel found

verification.failureMessage: countVowels('hello') should be 2 (e, o), countVowels('why') should be 0.

steps.title: Case-insensitive counting
steps.description: Make `countVowels` count both uppercase and lowercase vowels.
hints: Convert the string to lowercase before looping
str.toLowerCase() for JS, str.lower() for Python

verification.failureMessage: countVowels('HELLO') should be 2, countVowels('AEIOU') should be 5.

steps.title: Count per vowel type
steps.description: Write a `countEachVowel` function that returns an object with counts for each vowel (a, e, i, o, u).
hints: Create an object with a/e/i/o/u set to 0
Loop through the string and increment the matching vowel count

verification.successMessage: Each vowel is counted separately! "hello world" has 1 e and 1 o.
verification.failureMessage: The object should have separate counts for a, e, i, o, u.

steps.title: Return a summary object
steps.description: Write a `getVowelReport` function that returns total vowel count, counts per vowel, and the consonant count.
hints: Return an object with all three pieces of data

verification.successMessage: Complete vowel report with totals, per-vowel counts, and consonants!
verification.failureMessage: The report should have total vowels, counts per vowel, and total consonants.
